form.label: 5. Etikettendrucker — Environmental Device Health
form.description: Catch equipment failing from environmental conditions (heat, humidity) before it fails, by correlating room sensors with device error logs.

html.p: "…Etikettendrucker der dieses Jahr aufgrund steigender Temperaturen nicht mehr funktioniert hat." — nobody was watching room temperature and the device log together.

panel.title: Room temperature vs. printer errors (7 days)

search.query: | makeresults count=7 | streamstats count as i | eval Day=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(7-i)."d"), "%m-%d") | eval "Room temp (°C, Storage-2)"=case(i<=4, 22+i, i=5, 31, i=6, 34, i=7, 29) | eval "Printer error count"=case(i<=4, 0, i=5, 2, i=6, 9, i=7, 1) | table Day "Room temp (°C, Storage-2)" "Printer error count"
| makeresults count=3 | streamstats count as i | eval Category=case(i=1,"Within range",i=2,"Near limit",i=3,"Over limit") | eval Count=case(i=1,61,i=2,2,i=3,1) | table Category Count

panel.title: Devices currently trending outside their rated operating range

search.query: | makeresults count=3 | streamstats count as i | eval Device=case(i=1,"Label-Printer-Storage-2",i=2,"Network-Cabinet-B12",i=3,"UPS-Ward4") | eval Location=case(i=1,"Storage room 2, Bldg B",i=2,"IDF closet B12",i=3,"Ward 4 electrical room") | eval "Current temp"=case(i=1,"34°C",i=2,"27°C",i=3,"24°C") | eval "Rated max"=case(i=1,"30°C",i=2,"35°C",i=3,"40°C") | eval Status=case(i=1,"Over limit",i=2,"Within range",i=3,"Within range") | table Device Location "Current temp" "Rated max" Status
